detailed_descriptions.en: "Incredible things coming out of Latin America right now" -Hakita (Creator of Ultrakill) about the game "This game is f*cking crazy" - James Rolfe (Cinemassacre, The Angry Video Game Nerd) "John Brazil/You shot a lot f¨&$ you I don't give a s*$¨/GOTY 2025" -Vinny (Vinesauce) "I picked up a lotta cool weapons!!!!" -Charlie (MoistCr1TiKaL) " I just impulse bought this game. This is probably the most realistic depiction of Rio de Janeiro I've ever seen in a video game. " -Chance Glasco (Co-Founder of Infinity Ward from Call of Duty) " BDD3 plays, looks, and sounds like a retro fever dream, complete with loud, ear-piercing music, random sound effects, bizarre textures everywhere you look, and oddly shaped levels based on real-life locations . " "I had a blast playing BDD3. " -Zack Zwiezen (Kotaku) " One of 2025’s best releases " -Joel Loynds (The Escapist) "BRAZILIAN DRUG DEALER 3: I OPENED A PORTAL TO HELL IN THE FAVELA TRYING TO REVIVE MIT AIA I NEED TO CLOSE IT is the best boomer shooter of 2025 and I think everyone should play it ." -Civvie IMPORTANT : THIS GAME WILL CONTINUE RECEIVING NEW UPDATES AND MAPS EVEN AFTER 1.0!! BRAZILIAN DRUG DEALER 3 is a fast-paced ultraviolent BRAZILIAN old school FPS heavily inspired by the first Quake, and using the same engine as the game (ID TECH2). It is A TRIBUTE TO THE BRAZILIAN MODS OF THE 2000S, THE BRAZILIAN BOOTLEG GAMES OF THE 2000S, BRAZILIAN MUSIC AND THE KING OF BRAZILIAN MUSIC, MIT AIA! YOU ARE A MIT AIA FAN, A LEGEND OF BRAZILIAN 70S FUNK MUSIC, AND YOU TRIED TO REVIVE HIM IN THE FAVELA WHERE YOU LIVE WITH A PENTAGRAM, THINGS TOOK A BAD TURN AND YOU OPENED A PORTAL TO HELL! ALL THE PEOPLE IN THE STATE OF RIO DE JANEIRO GOT POSSEEESSED! IT'S UP TO YOU TO FIND A WAY TO STOP THE HELL INVASION! Use your quake-ish movement abilities to stay mobile and avoid the relentless attacks of the dead, demons and other BRAZILIAN POSSESSED. ALMOST EVERY WEAPON IN THE GAME IS BATHED IN GOLD AND ALSO THE ROCKET LAUNCHER HAS THE COLORS OF YOUR FAVORITE BRAZILIAN TEAM, FLAFLAMENCO! CRAZY WEAPONS LIKE BERIMBAU, PAYPHONE THAT SHOOTS COCONUTS AND MONEY PAPER AIRPLANE GUN!! A BUNCH OF ENEMIES GOING FROM ARMED DEMONS TO ZOMBIES, BRAZILIAN TRUCK CLOWNS AND EVEN POSSESSED BRAZILIAN SINGERS! 56 STAGES GOING THROUGH THE ENTIRE STATE OF RIO DE JANEIRO, PARTS OF SÃO PAULO, AMAZONIA, SPACE, HELL AND EVEN HEAVEN! SAVE RIO AND SAVE MIT AIA! (29 CAMPAIGN STAGES, 21 HORDE MAPS, 3 GOBLIN MODE MAPS AND 3 DM MAPS!) (wow what happened! the game had 18 maps in the day early access launched, things change fast, it's TRIPLE the size lol) LOTS OF SECRET AREAS ON EACH LEVEL! -COOPERATIVE AND DEATHMATCH ON ALL CAMPAIGN MAPS -EAT PASTEL AND DRINK CANE BROTH TO GAIN HEALTH! IT'S SCATTERED ON THE MAPS! REPLAY THE GAME WITH ROCKET JUMPING TO FIND EXCLUSIVE ROCKET JUMP SECRET AREAS! OLD SCHOOL 90S STYLE! ATTENTION : THE GAME WILL STILL RECEIVE CONTENT MONTHLY EVEN AFTER 1.0!
